pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 88
   C. 38
   D. 19

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 169
   D. 26

5. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 17

7. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

8. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 40.5

9. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 9

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 30
   C. 46
   D. 23

14. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

15. Solve for x: x + 8 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 12

16. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

17. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

18. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 40

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

20. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 65

21. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

22. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

23. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

24. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

25. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

26. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

27. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

28. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

29. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 8

30. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 37

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
